content: Wɛɛ Sɔl kàkyer akyey nkweel a Ityen. Pɔl kan'mɛɛy Ikööŋ nkwaaŋ. Ilä nsil akin nkwaaŋ a ngwal yàsɛmà ntɔn Ikööŋ a Yɛlusàlɛm. Baar bàkyey ndaa a Nzam banswà bàtɛ upay u Yuday anà u Samàlya. Antööm mpɛl bàsàsal.
Apan, baar a mpem aŋàbwaŋ bàdyee Ityen, waa bun'lel mbɔɔn.
Wɛɛ Sɔl kàkyer ngwal mudwa Ikööŋ, nde kàyibilà u ndwà mukɔr abaal anà akaar anà mukabiil u bɔlokà.
Filipo u Samalya
Baar abà bàpää bàyilyaaŋà ntsü anà ntsü mupay Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ là Ndaa.
Lalan Filipo kàkyen nde bul mwɛy là Samalya mukyään ba làsaŋ a Klistɔ.
Apan, unsà un'tüüb, in'sɛŋ a baar myàkäl maàŋàbääb u ndaa kàtɛɛnà Filipo ntɔn ba bàweemà anà bàmɛnà impà kàkyerà nde.
Abun, an'dweelà an'be màkyer atɔɔ akà baar bàkäl anà ma u ndaa a ngwal. Baar aŋàkwɛkà anà ikar bàkyer akɔɔrà.
Lalan, un'sak kàkäl wàmbɔɔn u bul alan.
Wɛɛ u bul alan kàfwel anà mbuur mwɛy ikɔb ande Simɔn. Nde kàfakyerà inwɛŋ anà kàbemà ngwal un'sɛŋ a Samàlya. Nde kakyeyà uyɔl naa nde mpɛl awà mbuur a kölàköl.
Apan, baar banswà, sɛmà baan akye tii akà andweer, bun'wemà unsà igyɛɛŋ kyanswà mutɛɛnà naa: « Mbuur awà wà ngwal a Nzam ayà bàfàbel naa: "Ngwal a kölàköl." »
Ba bun'weemà kà igyɛɛŋ, ntɔn ba bàbemà inwɛŋ ande taaŋ mbɔɔn.
Wɛɛ umpal bàkyey ba Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ là imfum a Nzam anà ikɔb a Yɛsu Klistɔ kàlɔɔŋà Filipo, abaal anà akaar bàwɛl ndüümà.
Simɔn ŋakwo sye kàsi làkwikilà, waa kàwɛl ndüümà, wɛɛ nde Filipo kun'wɛy anki, ntɔn nde kàkyer abemà muman idiim anà ndaa a ngwal yàlyaaŋà.
Mpal ban'wem Antööm bàkäl u Yɛlusàlɛm naa baar a Samàlya ban'kyey Ndaa a Nzam, ba batööm Petɔlà anà Ywan.
Mpal bàyàkɔlà ba u Samàlya, ba bàyamà ntɔn ba naa ba bàwɛl Dweelà In'kyɛɛl.
Ntɔn Dweelà In'kyɛɛl kàkäl aŋàtàyàtyà anki akà udu a umwɛy uboo a ba: ba badümà mpɛl kà ikɔb a Mwol Yɛsu.
Abun, Petɔlà anà Ywan bàsi an'kɔɔ, ba waa bàwɛl Dweelà In'kyɛɛl.
Abà kàmɛn Simɔn naa baar bàwɛlà Dweelà mpal basi Antööm an'kɔɔ, nde kàpɛ Petɔlà anà Ywan in'naaŋ,
waa kàtɛn naa: « Lan'pɛ mɛ sye ikɔ̈b, ntɔn taaŋ in'yasaa mɛ baar an'kɔɔ ba sye bàwɛl Dweelà In'kyɛɛl. »
Wɛɛ Petɔlà kun'fuur naa: « Wɛy ngim angye ikü anà ngye ŋakwo ntɔn ngye akasii naa kab a Nzam bàfàsom a in'naaŋ!
Uboo a ndaa ayi, ngye akà kitiir, akà yar latɛy, ntɔn mpem angye kà yàbalàbal anki kusà a Nzam.
Buul mpem angye, yamà Mwol ntɔn u taaŋ lumwɛy, nde akyer awem ngyɛb unsà an'kyän awà ngye amà.
Mɛ an'man naa ndandaa ngye awɛ anà ube bàŋàsöön anà ngye awà un'sɔ a ube. »
Waa Simɔn kàtɛn naa: « Bɛ ŋakwo làyamà Mwol ntɔn mɛ, ntɔn undiir mwɛy ukɔ̈ɔ̈n ayà unsà ya yanswà lan'tɛn bɛ yi. »
Ungö mutà imbäl anà mulɔŋ ndaa a Mwol, ba bàfurà Yɛlusàlɛm. U mbwo ba bàyipayà Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ uboo an'bul mbɔɔn mà Samàlya.
Filipo anà mbuur a isal a Ɛtyɔpi
Yàmɛnà naa un'kyeey a Mwol mwɛy kàyääm anà Filipo, waa kàtɛn naa: « Mbarà, kyen ntsü a ngyɛl, u mbwo ifàtyà sɛmà Yɛlusàlɛm tii u Gaza. Mbwo ayi yà ipɔl. »

Apan Filipo waa kàmbarà, kàkyen agyägyä. Kyekà yɔl mwɛy wà Ɛtyɔpi, mbuur a isal a kölàköl, isal ande musyäl un'naaŋ a Kandase, mfum un'kaar a Ɛtyɔpi, nde kàfü Yɛlusàlɛm ntɔn mukàkömà Nzam.
Mpal kàfurà nde, nde kàkäl aŋàbwaay udu a shar wàmutaŋ un'kaan a ŋangɔɔm Yɛsay.
Dweelà waa kàtɛn a Filipo naa: « Sin, kabweey a shar lanà. »
Apan, Filipo kàkyà ntiin, waa kàwem mbuur a Ɛtyɔpi wàmutaŋ u ndaa a ngwal un'kaan a ŋangɔɔm Yɛsay. Filipo waa kun'fuul naa: « Nkye ngye akiyöbà ndaa akataŋà ngye yi? »
Nde kàfuur naa: « Mɛ an'kwo muyöb aben, isàkal naa mbuur kan'buul anki? » Nde kàlɔ̈ɔ̈m Filipo mulaar anà mubwaay ukɔl a nde.
Itiir a ndaa kàtäŋà nde kyaki:

content.text: « Nde kàkäl asànaa un'kɔk bàfàsyen kà idwääl,
asànaa mwan a un'kɔk mpa afàsà ndaa kusà a mbuur awà kun'kɔɔlà in'kà.
Uboo a làbɔ̈ɔ̈n ande, nde kàwɛl anki iböŋ.
Nà kan'kwo mutɛn ntɔn ikyee ande?
Ntɔn mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande bàkyer alwom u mɛɛn. »

content: Wɛɛ yɔl a Ɛtyɔpi kàfuul Filipo naa: « Mɛ amabɔɔn, nkyään, ntɔn nà ŋangɔɔm ukatɛɛnà nde abà? Ntɔn nde ŋakwo lɛɛ ntɔn mbuur asin? »
Filipo kàduub mun, waa kàsɛmà kà itiir a ndaa aŋàsɔn aki, mukun'kyään Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ là Yɛsu.
Ba bàkäl mulab mbwo aba, waa bàkɔlà kà ikal mwɛy kyàkäl anà an'dà. Yɔl awà kàtɛn naa: « Le an'dà, undiir nà kan'kɔɔn mukan'dümà? »
Apan, Filipo waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Isàkal naa ngye an'kyey u mpem angye yanswà, ngye an'kwo awɛl ndüümà. » Mbuur awà waa kàfuur naa: « Mɛ an'kyey naa Yɛsu Klistɔ wà Mwan a Nzam. »
Apan nde kàswɛŋ mubäm shar ande. Ba bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l, Filipo anà yɔl, bàtɔlà kan'dà, waa Filipo kun'dümà.
Umpal bàtoo ba kà an'dà, Dweelà a Mwol kàsyen Filipo, yɔl kàfun'man anki. Wɛɛ nde kàläb mbwo ande unsà un'sak.
Apan, Filipo kàkàmɛnà u Azɔt, nde kàyipayà Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ kà an'bul manswà kàlyaaŋà nde tii u Sɛzarɛ.
